data.title: War Elephants ready to strike first in Bangkok
data.description: <p>Thailand will face defending champions Vietnam in the first leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup 2026 final at Rajamangala National Stadium tonight, looking to avenge their defeat against their fierce rivals in the title decider two years ago.</p>

data.title: Maresca needs time to succeed after ‘big changes’ at Man City
data.description: LONDON - Enzo Maresca insists he can replicate Manchester City’s success under Pep Guardiola if he is given time to handle the “big changes” at the club.

data.title: Premier League returns with Arsenal eyeing title dynasty
data.description: LONDON - Champions Arsenal kick off the Premier League season on Friday (2am Saturday Thailand time) reinforced by astute signings as boss Mikel Arteta welcomes the pressure of being “hunted” by their title rivals.

data.title: ONE Championship: Takeru hopes future fighters emerge from Myanmar school he helped fund
data.description: Retired Japanese kickboxing great Takeru Segawa hopes future fighters and athletes emerge from a school in Myanmar after finally visiting a new building he helped fund there.

data.title: Maradona trial on hold over possible medical evidence mix-up
data.description: SAN ISIDRO (ARGENTINA) - The latest trial over the death of Argentine football legend Diego Maradona was suspended Thursday following claims that kidney test results presented to the court came from his father.

data.title: 'Greatest' Springboks face All Blacks in clash of juggernauts
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - Springbok legend Victor Matfield believes the current South Africa team is the "greatest we have ever had".

data.title: Champions Arsenal embrace being 'hunted' as Premier League returns
data.description: LONDON - Mikel Arteta said Arsenal will embrace being "hunted" by their title rivals as the new Premier League season kicks off with the champions facing Coventry on Friday.

data.title: Kunlavut rolls into quarters, Pornpawee survives a thriller
data.description: <p>Kunlavut Vitidsarn cruised into the quarter-finals of the BWF World Championships 2026 in New Delhi on Thursday, while Pornpawee Chochuwong battled her way into the last eight of the sport's showpiece event.</p>

data.title: Spikers eye Olympic berth, face Australia in the opener
data.description: <p>Thailand begin their title defence at the AVC Asian Women's Volleyball Continental Championship 2026 against Australia on Friday in Tianjin, China.</p>

data.title: Verstappen signs new Red Bull contract until 2030
data.description: ZANDVOORT, Netherlands - Four-time Formula One world champion Max Verstappen has signed a new contract with Red Bull until the end of 2030, the team announced Thursday, ending speculation over his future in the sport.

data.title: Australian Rules faces far-reaching fallout from latest scandal
data.description: SYDNEY - An alcohol-fuelled scandal swirling around a top Australian Rules team has been splashed across newspaper front pages as much as the back and triggered broader debate, a sign of the sport’s importance in the country’s social fabric.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri backs Suakim decision but says Nabil rematch warranted
data.description: ONE Championship chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong believes Thai veteran Suakim Pongsuphan PK did enough to beat Nabil Anane – but says their disputed split decision is worthy of a rematch.

data.title: Arteta says Arsenal can become world’s best club
data.description: LONDON - Mikel Arteta has warned Arsenal’s rivals that he plans to build the Premier League champions into the “best club in the world”.

data.title: Mourinho begins second Real Madrid reign with Barca in his sights
data.description: BARCELONA - Jose Mourinho's second spell at Real Madrid begins in Barcelona this weekend in La Liga, although at Espanyol rather than up against his and Los Blancos' bitter rivals.

data.title: Tough ACL Elite opener for Buriram
data.description: <p>Thai League 1 champions Buriram United will kick off their AFC Champions League Elite campaign with a tough away match against Malaysia's Johor Darul Ta'zim on Sept 15 after the draw for the expanded competition was conducted in Kuala Lumpur on Tuesday.</p>

data.title: Dechapol and Supissara survive scare, reach last 16
data.description: <p>Mixed doubles pairs Dechapol Puavaranukroh/Supissara Paewsampran and Pakkapon Teeraratsakul/Sapsiree Taerattanachai advanced to the last 16 of the BWF World Championships 2026 in New Delhi on Wednesday.</p>

data.title: Thai march fails to appease fans
data.description: <p>Social media erupted once again as Thailand fell 2-1 to Singapore at home in Tuesday night's second leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup semi-final, yet advanced to the final on a 4-3 aggregate.</p>

data.title: Proadprans lands SAT governor job
data.description: <p>Proadprans Samarnmit has been selected as the 14th governor of the Sports Authority of Thailand (SAT), pending Cabinet approval, becoming the first woman chosen to lead the national sports governing body.</p>

data.title: Kyrgios admits 'huge mistake' after failing test for cocaine
data.description: LONDON — Australian tennis star Nick Kyrgios said on Wednesday he had made "a huge mistake" after he was provisionally suspended for testing positive for cocaine.

data.title: Five Premier League stars to watch this season
data.description: LONDON - The new Premier League season kicks off on Friday, setting the stage for a galaxy of stars to shine in the 2026-27 campaign.
